name: Zurmo
tagline: Gamified open source CRM. Sales, marketing, service, with a unique twist.
shortDescription: An open source CRM with built-in gamification (badges, points, leaderboards) to encourage user adoption. Sales, marketing, service modules. PHP + MySQL.
longDescription:
## What it is

Zurmo is an open source CRM with a unique feature: built-in gamification. Users earn points, badges, and leaderboard positions for completing tasks, logging activities, and closing deals. Sales, marketing, service modules, customizable workflows.

## Why we recommend it

If user adoption is your #1 CRM problem, gamification can help. Zurmo is the only open source CRM that bakes in this mechanic. It works surprisingly well for sales teams that need a nudge.

## When to use it

- Sales teams with low CRM adoption
- Companies that want gamification to drive usage
- Standard sales/marketing/service workflows
- Custom workflow-heavy use cases
installCommand: git clone https://github.com/zurmo/zurmo && cd zurmo && php install.php
installInstructions:
**Manual install:**
1. LAMP with PHP 7.4+
2. Clone the repo
3. `php install.php` and follow the wizard

Note: Zurmo's release pace has slowed, but the codebase is still maintained.
pricingDetails: Free. Open source under AGPL-3.0. Self-host on LAMP.
